body.zh-Hant: 宇垣纏（1890—1945）生於岡山縣，是海軍中將。他於明治45年（1912）畢業於海軍兵學校第40期，大正13年（1924）畢業於海軍大學。其後擔任海軍軍令部員，昭和3年（1928）駐在德國，並曾任第5戰隊、第2艦隊的參謀。
body.en: Ugaki Matome (1890-1945), a vice admiral, was born in Okayama Prefecture. He graduated from the Naval Academy (40th class) in 1912 and from the Naval War College in 1924. He then served on the Naval General Staff, was stationed in Germany in 1928, and served on the staffs of the 5th Squadron and the 2nd Fleet.

citations.quote: 大正・昭和期の海軍中将
岡山県
海兵(第40期)〔明治45年〕卒,海大〔大正13年〕卒
軍令部員となり昭和3年ドイツ駐在
第5戦隊、第2艦隊各参謀

heading.zh-Hant: 教官、艦長與軍令部第1部長
heading.en: Instructor, ship captain and chief of the First Division

body.zh-Hant: 昭和7年（1932）他任海軍大學教官與聯合艦隊參謀，並分別擔任「八雲」「日向」的艦長。昭和13年（1938）任軍令部第1部長。
body.en: In 1932 he served as an instructor at the Naval War College and as a Combined Fleet staff officer, and he captained the Yakumo and the Hyuga. In 1938 he became chief of the First Division of the Naval General Staff.

citations.quote: 7年海軍大学教官、連合艦隊参謀、「八雲」「日向」各艦長
13年軍令部第1部長

heading.zh-Hant: 聯合艦隊參謀長與珍珠港
heading.en: Combined Fleet chief of staff and Pearl Harbor

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941）4月他任第8戰隊司令長官，同年8月任聯合艦隊參謀長，在山本五十六司令長官之下參加珍珠港攻擊。昭和18年（1943）4月，山本長官的座機自拉包爾出發後被擊落，山本陣亡；乘坐二號機的宇垣身負重傷、被拋入海中後獲救。
body.en: In April 1941 he became commander of the 8th Squadron and in August of that year chief of staff of the Combined Fleet, taking part in the Pearl Harbor attack under Commander-in-Chief Yamamoto Isoroku. In April 1943 Yamamoto's aircraft, which had left Rabaul, was shot down and Yamamoto was killed; Ugaki, aboard the second aircraft, was badly injured, thrown into the sea, and rescued.

citations.quote: 16年4月第8戦隊司令長官、同8月連合艦隊参謀長となり、山本五十六司令長官の下で真珠湾攻撃に参加
18年4月ラバウルを出発した山本長官機は撃墜され戦死
2番機の宇垣は重傷、海中に投げ出され救助された

heading.zh-Hant: 第5航空艦隊與最後的特攻
heading.en: Fifth Air Fleet and the last kamikaze sortie

body.zh-Hant: 昭和19年（1944）他任第1戰隊司令官；昭和20年（1945）2月任第5航空艦隊司令長官，指揮對沖繩的特攻作戰。8月15日他在廣播中聽到終戰詔書後，自大分基地率領彗星機11架，向沖繩的敵艦船群發動最後一次特攻進攻。
body.en: In 1944 he commanded the 1st Battleship Division; in February 1945 he became commander-in-chief of the 5th Air Fleet and directed the special-attack (kamikaze) operations against Okinawa. On 15 August, after hearing the surrender rescript on the radio, he led 11 Suisei aircraft from Oita base in a final attack on the enemy fleet off Okinawa.

body.zh-Hant: 安藤利吉（1884—1946）生於宮城縣仙台市，是陸軍大將，畢業於陸軍士官學校第16期與陸軍大學。明治37年（1904）任步兵少尉，其後曾駐在英國，並在參謀本部任職。
body.en: Ando Rikichi (1884-1946), an army general, was born in Sendai, Miyagi Prefecture, and graduated from the Army Academy (16th class) and the Army War College. He became an infantry second lieutenant in 1904, was later stationed in Britain, and served on the Army General Staff.

citations.quote: 宮城県仙台市
陸士(第16期)卒,陸大卒
明治37年歩兵少尉、イギリス駐在、参謀本部員

heading.en: War Ministry posts and division command

body.zh-Hant: 昭和6年（1931）他任陸軍省兵務課長，昭和7年（1932）任駐英國大使館武官，其後歷任步兵第1旅團長、教育總監部本部長與第5師團長。
body.en: In 1931 he became chief of the Military Service Section of the War Ministry and in 1932 military attache at the embassy in Britain; he then served as commander of the 1st Infantry Brigade, head of the Inspectorate General of Military Training headquarters, and commander of the 5th Division.

citations.quote: 昭和6年陸軍省兵務課長、7年イギリス大使館付武官、歩兵第1旅団長、教育総監部本部長、第5師団長

heading.zh-Hant: 南寧攻略與北部佛印進駐
heading.en: Nanning and the northern Indochina occupation

body.zh-Hant: 昭和13年（1938）他任第21軍司令官，指揮南寧攻略作戰（進攻南寧）。昭和15年（1940）任南支那方面軍司令官，違反中央命令執行對北部佛印的武力進駐，被追究責任，翌年轉為預備役。
body.en: In 1938 he commanded the 21st Army and directed the Nanning offensive. In 1940 he became commander of the South China Area Army and, against orders from the central authorities, carried out the armed advance into northern French Indochina; held responsible, he was placed on the reserve list the next year.

citations.quote: 13年第21軍司令官として南寧攻略作戦を指揮
15年南支那方面軍司令官となり、中央の命に反し北部仏印武力進駐を決行、責任を問われて翌16年予備役

heading.zh-Hant: 台灣軍、第10方面軍與台灣總督
heading.en: Taiwan Army, 10th Area Army and Governor-General of Taiwan

body.zh-Hant: 昭和16年（1941）他被召集並任台灣軍司令官，昭和19年（1944）晉升大將，任第10方面軍司令官並兼任台灣總督；國立公文書館所藏「任台灣總督 陸軍大將 安藤利吉」之任命文書作成於昭和19年12月30日，作成者為內閣總理大臣小磯國昭。戰後他以戰犯身分被關押在上海監獄，昭和21年（1946）4月19日服毒自殺。
body.en: In 1941 he was recalled to service as commander of the Taiwan Army; in 1944 he was promoted general and became commander of the 10th Area Army, concurrently Governor-General of Taiwan. The National Archives appointment document "Appointment of Army General Ando Rikichi as Governor-General of Taiwan" was drawn up on 30 December 1944 by Prime Minister Koiso Kuniaki. After the war he was held as a war criminal in Shanghai prison and died by poison on 19 April 1946.

body.zh-Hant: 小澤治三郎（1886—1966）生於宮崎縣，是海軍中將，畢業於海軍兵學校第37期與海軍大學校。他歷任驅逐艦「竹」艦長、聯合艦隊參謀、驅逐隊司令、海軍大學校教官，並曾擔任巡洋艦「摩耶」與戰艦「榛名」的艦長。
body.en: Ozawa Jisaburo (1886-1966), a vice admiral, was born in Miyazaki Prefecture and graduated from the Naval Academy (37th class) and the Naval War College. He served as captain of the destroyer Take, Combined Fleet staff officer, destroyer division commander and Naval War College instructor, and captained the cruiser Maya and the battleship Haruna.

citations.quote: 海軍軍人。宮崎県生まれ。海軍兵学校37期、海軍大学校卒業。

heading.en: Chief of staff and school head

body.zh-Hant: 昭和12年（1937）他任聯合艦隊參謀長，之後歷任水雷學校長與海軍大學校長；昭和16年（1941）任海軍大學校校長。
body.en: In 1937 he became chief of staff of the Combined Fleet and later headed the Torpedo School and the Naval War College; in 1941 he was president of the Naval War College.

heading.en: Southern Expeditionary Fleet and the Malayan operation

body.zh-Hant: 1941年10月，他任南遣艦隊司令官，在太平洋戰爭開戰之際擔任馬來作戰的海軍指揮官，擊沉英國戰艦威爾斯親王號與反擊號。
body.en: In October 1941 he became commander of the Southern Expeditionary Fleet; at the outbreak of the Pacific War he was naval commander for the Malayan operation, in which the British battleships Prince of Wales and Repulse were sunk.

heading.zh-Hant: 馬里亞納與雷伊泰灣海戰

body.zh-Hant: 1944年他兼任第一機動艦隊與第三艦隊司令長官。同年6月的馬里亞納海戰中損失航空母艦3艘與飛機400餘架；10月的雷伊泰灣海戰（菲律賓海戰）中，他率航空母艦部隊自北方接近、擔任誘餌牽制美軍航母機動部隊，但因栗田艦隊折返而未奏效，並損失航母4艘。
body.en: In 1944 he held the posts of commander-in-chief of both the First Mobile Fleet and the Third Fleet. In the Battle of the Philippine Sea in June that year he lost three carriers and over 400 aircraft; at Leyte Gulf in October he led the carrier force from the north as a decoy to draw off the US carrier task force, but because Kurita's fleet turned back the plan failed, and four carriers were lost.

citations.quote: 1944年第一機動艦隊と第三艦隊の司令長官を兼任
同年6月のマリアナ沖海戦で航空母艦 (空母) 3隻と航空機 400機余を失った
10月のフィリピン海戦ではおとりとして空母部隊を率い北方から接近
栗田(くりた)艦隊の反転で功を奏さなかった
空母4隻その他水上艦3隻を失った

body.zh-Hant: 他其後任軍令部次長與海軍總隊長官；1945年他任海軍總隊司令長官兼聯合艦隊司令長官，為最後的聯合艦隊司令長官。戰後他協助防衛廳的戰史編纂與鄉友聯盟的創設。
body.en: He later served as vice chief of the Navy General Staff and as head of the Navy General Command; in 1945 he was commander-in-chief of the Navy General Command and concurrently of the Combined Fleet, the last Combined Fleet commander. After the war he assisted the Defense Agency's war-history compilation and the founding of the Goyu Renmei.

body.zh-Hant: 小磯國昭（1880—1950）是陸軍大將與政治家，生於宇都宮，原籍山形縣。他明治33年（1900）畢業於陸軍士官學校（第12期），參加日俄戰爭，明治43年（1910）畢業於陸軍大學校。大正6年（1917）他任參謀本部兵要地誌班長，寫成《帝國國防資源》，成為國家總動員研究的先驅。
body.en: Koiso Kuniaki (1880-1950), an army general and politician, was born in Utsunomiya, with family roots in Yamagata. He graduated from the Army Academy (12th class) in 1900, served in the Russo-Japanese War, and graduated from the Army War College in 1910. In 1917, as head of the geographic survey section of the Army General Staff, he wrote the essay "Imperial National Defense Resources", a pioneering study of total national mobilization.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍務局長、次官與關東軍參謀長
heading.en: Bureau chief, vice-minister and Kwantung Army chief of staff

body.zh-Hant: 昭和5年（1930）他任陸軍省軍務局長，與三月事件有關；1932年2月在荒木陸相之下任陸軍次官，同年8月起任關東軍參謀長兼特務部長，對建國不久的滿洲國施加影響。
body.en: In 1930 he became chief of the War Ministry Military Affairs Bureau and was implicated in the March Incident. In February 1932 he became vice-minister of war under War Minister Araki, and from August that year he was chief of staff of the Kwantung Army and head of its Special Affairs Department, wielding influence over the newly founded Manchukuo.

heading.zh-Hant: 朝鮮軍司令官與拓務大臣

body.zh-Hant: 他自1935年12月至1938年7月任朝鮮軍司令官，昭和12年（1937）晉升大將，13年轉為預備役。昭和14年（1939）起在平沼內閣與米內內閣擔任拓務大臣，主張南進。
body.en: From December 1935 to July 1938 he commanded the Korea Army; he was promoted general in 1937 and placed on the reserve list in 1938. From 1939 he served as Colonial Minister in the Hiranuma and Yonai cabinets, advocating a southward advance.

heading.en: Governor-General of Korea and Prime Minister

body.zh-Hant: 他自1942年5月起任朝鮮總督。1944年7月東條內閣倒台後，他組閣出任首相；防衛研究所的史料介紹寫道，他想兼任陸軍大臣以介入統帥而被陸軍拒絕，因此設置最高戰爭指導會議，圖謀統一國務與統帥。同年10月美軍登陸菲律賓雷伊泰島，陸海軍統帥部以該島為決戰場而未能獲勝。他於1945年4月總辭，戰後被認定為甲級戰犯，終身監禁，1950年11月3日在巢鴨收容所病逝。
body.en: From May 1942 he was Governor-General of Korea. In July 1944, after the fall of the Tojo cabinet, he formed a government as prime minister. The National Institute for Defense Studies notes that he sought to take the war portfolio concurrently so as to have a say in supreme command but was refused by the army, and so set up the Supreme War Direction Council to unify state affairs and command. In October 1944 US forces landed on Leyte in the Philippines, which the army and navy commands chose as the decisive battlefield but did not win. His cabinet resigned in April 1945; after the war he was convicted as a Class-A war criminal, sentenced to life imprisonment, and died in Sugamo on 3 November 1950.
